children: Japanese stocks may decline following drops in U.S. technology shares overnight as concerns about higher energy costs continue. Nikkei futures are down 1.6% at 62230 on the SGX. The dollar is at 156.55 yen, compared with Y157.19 as of Thursday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on crude oil prices and developments in Ukraine and the Middle East. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 2.7% to 62907.84 on Thursday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
